title: These Popular ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Toys Are Discounted Up to 46% Off for Prime Day: Shop the Deals Before They Sell Out
summary: Amazon has a range of officially-licensed Demon Hunters toys, books, games and merch on sale right now.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Amazon Prime Day 2026 is here and aside from deals on top tech and electronics , the retailer is also showing more than 50% off popular toys and collectibles.

Of course, few collectibles were as popular this year as items from the hit Netflix film, KPop Demon Hunters , and Amazon has a range of officially-licensed Demon Hunters toys, books, games and merch on sale right now.

Here’s a look at what to shop online. A reminder: the best Prime day deals and discounted pricing will only be available to Amazon Prime members so you’ll need to be logged in with your Prime details. Not a Prime member? Get a 30-day free trial to test out the service here .

KPop Demon Hunters: Official Activity Book

$8.97 $9.99 10% off

Buy Now On Amazon

This official book from Netflix and Random House features 48 pages of trivia, puzzles, mazes, quizzes and coloring pages inspired by the movie themes and characters.

The book was first released in March and is on sale for Prime Day. You can find more KPop Demon Hunters books on sale here .

Monopoly Deal: Kpop Demon Hunters Card Game

$8.99 $9.99 10% off

The KPop Demon Hunters Monopoly Deal game came out earlier this year and gets its first discount during Prime Day.

In this game, players compete to collect items or fulfil actions that Rumi, Mira, and Zoey need to make their concert and seal the Honmoon. The first player to assemble three complete sets wins.

Kpop Demon Hunters Journal Set

$9.49 $11.99 21% off

Write down your favorite lyrics, motivational quotes, big goals or innermost thoughts in this official KPop Demon Hunters journal set.

This set gets you a 40-page hardcover journal with the HUNTR/X girls on the cover. Inside, find specially-designed pages decorated with motifs from the film to help inspire your writing. The set also includes a gemstone-topped pen and puffy KPop Demon Hunters stickers.

Funko Pop! By Loungefly KPop Demon Hunters Mystery Box Pins

$10.10 $12.00 16% off

The blind box craze gets a Demon Hunters release with this mystery pin set.

Open to the box to reveal which HUNTR/X or Saja Boys character pin you receive, and pick up multiple boxes to have a chance at collecting them all. Each enamel pin measures approximately 1.5 inches tall.

Buffalo Games HUNTR/X Foil Jigsaw Puzzle

$12.99

This officially-licensed KPop Demon Hunters puzzle is an Amazon bestseller, with the site reporting more than 300 units sold in the last few weeks alone.

The 500-piece puzzle features a bold and striking image of HUNTR/X, with shimmering details throughout thanks to shiny foil pieces. The full-color puzzle measures 21.25 x 15 inches when completed. The set also includes a full-color poster.

KPop Demon Hunters Officially Licensed Water Bottle

$15.19 $27.99 46% off

One of the best Prime Day deals on KPop Demon Hunters toys and merch is on this officially-licensed water bottle.

The plastic bottle is certified BPA-free for safe drinking and features a leakproof lid, built-in straw and even a slot for your fingers at the top for easy gripping. This water bottle holds 25 oz. of liquid — or about 700 ml.

Crayola Kpop Demon Hunters Art Case

$18.49 $24.99 26% off

This KPop Demon Hunters x Crayola collab features coloring pages and stickers inspired by the characters in the film.

You get 20 Crayola markers, 40 coloring pages, three posters, and three sticker sheets, all housed in a portable carrying and storage case.

Funko Pop! Animation: Kpop Demon Hunters – Derpy With Sussie

$19.49 $26.90 28% off

Amazon also has the official KPop Demon Hunters Funko Pop figurines on sale for Prime Day. This Derpy vinyl figure features the supernatural tiger with his bird pal Sussie.

The Funko Pop measures approximately 4.3 inches tall and glows in the dark. It comes in a window pane box decorated with official movie branding for easy collecting and display.

Squishmallows Original Kpop Demon Hunters Derpy Plush

$20.89 $21.99 5% off

Forget about the KPop Demon Hunters hype — the Squishmallows train also shows no signs of slowing down and you can pick up this officially-licensed collab on Amazon now.

This is a 12-inch plush Squishmallow toy of Derpy in a super soft and cuddly material. You can find other Squishmallows from the animated film here .

Kpop Demon Hunters Friendship Bracelet Kit (3-Pack)

$21.21 $24.99 15% off

Get this friendship bracelet kit inspired by the friendship between Rumi, Mira and Zoey.

Each kit includes colorful beads, charms, rope and cords to make your own jewelry to keep or share with friends. The kit also includes a storage case and a bead tray to keep things organized. There are enough materials here to make 40 bracelets.

Funko Pop! Kpop Demon Hunters – Set of 3

$51.98 $72.95 29% off

You can also get this Funko Pop trio of the HUNTR/X girls, Rumi, Mira and Zoey.

Each character comes in their own Funko Pop box and the set also includes a box protector. The figurines each measure approximately 3.75 inches tall.

Want more merch from the Oscar-winning film ? Amazon’s Prime Day deals also include up to 25% off the Anua K-beauty collaboration with KPop Demon Hunters here .
